topic: Which Jackson-area Trustmark branches were sold in the $91.7 million sale-leaseback, and to whom
angle: Who bought what. The Wire's Sept. 22 story, from Trustmark's Sept. 10 SEC filing, reported that the bank sold 34 branch buildings in five states to entities affiliated with Blue Owl Real Estate Capital and leased them back for 15 years at $6.4 million a year, and that the bank says no branch will close. Find which of the 34 are in the Jackson metro from recorded deeds or Trustmark's own filings, name the buyer entity on each, and report any recorded price. Readers know their branch by its street, so give addresses. Add only what is new and confirmed.

topic: Westland Plaza after its $11.8 million sale: who bought it, which stores are open, and what is planned
angle: Who bought what. Readers search for Westland Plaza by name. The Wire's Aug. 9 story, built on trade coverage, reported the $11.8 million sale of the 214,000-square-foot center at 2590 Robinson Road at 83 percent occupancy. Name the buyer from the recorded deed or the buyer's own announcement, then report what has changed since: stores that opened, closed, or signed leases, and any building permits, site plans, or renovation filings. Add only what is new and confirmed.
